elementSpec.desc: describes the formatting requirements for an output produced by the parent processing model

attDef.desc: provides a way of defining pseudo-elements, that is, styling rules applicable to specific sub-portions of an element.

valItem.desc: styling applies to the first line of the target element.
styling applies to the first character of the target element.
styling should be applied immediately before the content of the target element.
styling should be applied immediately after the content of the target element.

remarks.p: This element provides means to document selected aspects of desired rendering of the output, important from the editorial perspective. Examples of such editorial decisions are for example the use of brackets to indicate conjectures, or following uncertain passages with a question mark.

It is important to note that the outputRendition should not be used for a comprehensive specification for the rendering of a particular output, for which the cssClass attribute of a model element is designed. It is also not intended as a description of the actual appearance of the source document, in contrast to the rendition element.
It is strongly recommended that the W3C Cascading Stylesheet language (CSS) should be used to express the editorial decisions regarding the output rendering.
